name: cloud-architecture-diagrams
description: Build editable cloud architecture diagrams (Azure/Microsoft, AWS, GCP, Microsoft Fabric) with official vendor icons, exported as both .excalidraw and .drawio. Bundles ~5,500 offline icons across AWS, Azure, GCP, the full Microsoft set (Dynamics 365, Power Platform, M365, Intune, Entra), and the official Microsoft Fabric Fluent set (all sizes/variants). Supports text-to-diagram and recreate-from-image, plus native draw.io vector stencils for AWS/GCP.
